full_sentence: Look at this big dog. It is very friendly.

options.why_wrong: 'They' is plural, but we are talking about one dog.
This describes where we are, but the sentence needs a description of the dog.
This introduces a different object, a shoe, instead of continuing about the dog.

grammar_focus: Demonstrative 'this' followed by the pronoun 'it' to refer back to the same object
explanation: After pointing at the dog with 'this', the next sentence uses the pronoun 'it' to talk about the same dog again. The completion must describe the dog, so it needs a singular pronoun.
translation: Bu büyük köpeğe bak. O çok arkadaş canlısı.
